description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories related to language models, divided into 10 slices. The categories are labeled as follows: Multitasking (dark teal, approximately 23%), Privacy Protection (light red, approximately 16%), Personalization (red, approximately 14%), Prioritization (pink, approximately 14%), Triggering (light blue, approximately 14%), Recursive Reasoning (blue, approximately 16%), Dynamic Environment (navy blue, approximately 14%), Memorization (light navy blue, approximately 14%), Dynamic Instruction (light teal, approximately 14%), and Context Retrieving (teal, approximately 16%), with Context Tracking (dark blue) and Contradiction Resolution (red-brown) being central labels but not directly corresponding to a specific slice. The chart does not include a legend, but labels are placed outside the chart, connected to their respective slices. The slices are visually distinct due to their different colors, and some have numerical values associated with them, ranging from 100 to 160. The slices appear to be ordered in a clockwise direction, with no particular slice being visually emphasized.
